summary: Quantum X Labs Inc., a Nasdaq-listed Israeli software company, furnished an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 announcing that Yossi Cohen, former Mossad Director (2016-2021) and Israeli National Security Advisor (2013-2016), joined as President of its Scientific Advisory Board. The September 15, 2026 press release notes Cohen joined SoftBank in 2021 to lead Vision Fund 2 activities in Israel and was appointed a SoftBank strategic advisor in August 2026. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors, or regulatory clock apply; this is an advisory-board appointment, not a special situation. Watch only for signaling value around strategic partnerships or capital access.
